confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Lugano prices. The price search returned only crowdsourced MyLifeElsewhere data in CHF, which varies between snapshots. It gave roughly CHF 25-28 for an inexpensive meal, CHF 3.65-3.88 for a cappuccino and CHF 6-8 for a domestic beer. It had no cocktail or wine figures, so those are estimated from the Swiss beer price relationship (cocktail about 2.5-3x beer, wine glass about 1.2-1.4x beer). The mid-range meal for two is a model estimate, not a searched figure. CHF-to-USD conversion used an approximate rate of about 1.25 USD per CHF. All accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no accommodation searches or listings inspected. Lugano is seasonal, so July lake-season hotel prices could be higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Lugano's own crowdsourced price data, which puts it slightly below the Swiss national average. Accommodation is benchmarked to other Swiss lakeside and Ticino tourist towns such as Locarno, and to Zurich at a modest discount.
